verdict.rationale: OpenCode has no llms.txt (the probe returned HTTP 404). Its docs do serve a markdown variant at /docs/.md, but that is raw Astro/MDX source with component imports rather than a clean agent-oriented digest. A machine-readable openapi.json is also served, which offers some agent-consumable documentation. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt index, clean agent-oriented markdown docs (not raw MDX), and documentation or corroboration that pointing an agent at these docs works well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
